title: STATE_PROJECTION_CONGRUENCE_AUDIT_FROM_PNP_TO_HODGE_WITNESS_REACHABILITY

source_atom.source_result: For fixed Lambda, the refined projection consisting of the base empty-set flag and membership bits for every E_i and H_i is a congruence for rule activation; a coarser both-antecedents-present vector is not.

target_atom.target_residual: Freeze a source-controlled witness moduli/deformation object W, projection pi:W->S, representative identity/replacement semantics, and relative tangent/obstruction geometry before another detector-faithfulness test.

common_abstraction.name: projection-as-state requires transition/reachability congruence
common_abstraction.formal_statement: For transition system (X, ->) and projection pi:X->Y, any claim that downstream reachability/property is determined solely by pi requires pi-equivalent source states to be indistinguishable by the registered downstream outcome. A pair with equal pi but different registered reachability/outcomes falsifies state sufficiency.
common_abstraction.transferred_operation: Before scoring or optimizing a compressed research representation, search for a collision pair with equal projected state but different downstream reachable sets or target outcome.

enabling_assumptions: a proposed compressed state/projection is explicitly defined
the downstream transition/reachability relation or target predicate is explicitly defined
source-valid examples can be compared under the same projection and target scope
disanalogies: PNP source is a finite monotone Boolean activation/closure system with fixed Lambda and an exactly enumerable recurrence.
Hodge target is geometric deformation/moduli with infinitesimal, formal and algebraic lifting distinctions, replacement witnesses, and source-specific semiregularity hypotheses.
No Boolean recurrence, circuit lower bound, or PNP theorem transfers to Hodge; only the state-sufficiency/congruence audit operation transfers.

primary_source_anchors.scope: source discrete-complexity/fusion framework; XM007 uses the application-derived fixed-Lambda congruence only as local calibration
positive Hodge calibration: under semiregularity, relative deformation of divisor maps iff the image cycle class remains Hodge
positive Hodge calibration: variational Hodge conjecture for complete-intersection cycles on hypersurfaces
hostile Hodge calibration: selected linear-cycle witness triple is rigid while specified Hodge loci can be smooth/reduced and positive-dimensional

target_prediction.principle: A Hodge witness representation should not be treated as sufficient state for witness deformation/reachability until its projection is congruent for the registered lifting/deformation outcome, or a source theorem supplies sufficiency under explicit hypotheses.
target_prediction.hostile_control: Movasati cubic setting warns that Hodge-locus motion need not be motion of the originally selected witness.

cheapest_target_falsifier.precondition: H4d1a1 first freezes W, pi, exact projected coordinates, and a binary/typed downstream witness-lift or deformation outcome.
cheapest_target_falsifier.test: Find two source-valid witness states w1,w2 (or admissible local deformation states) with pi(w1)=pi(w2) but different tangent/obstruction data or different registered witness-lift reachability. One such collision falsifies pi as sufficient state for that downstream outcome.
cheapest_target_falsifier.pass_branch: If no collision is found in bounded source families and a theorem proves congruence/sufficiency under explicit hypotheses, retain pi for the next detector-faithfulness test.
cheapest_target_falsifier.fail_branch: If a collision exists, refine the state with representative identity, replacement-witness class, tangent/obstruction data, or another source-defined coordinate.
cheapest_target_falsifier.cannot_check_branch: If W/pi/outcome are not frozen or source evidence cannot distinguish reachability, record CANNOT_CHECK rather than infer sufficiency.

changed_structural_coordinates: finite monotone Boolean recurrence -> geometric deformation/moduli
fixed finite antecedent bits -> witness identity/replacement and tangent-obstruction geometry
exactly enumerable reachability -> source/theorem-bound deformation reachability
restored_or_replaced_assumptions: replace source-specific Boolean transition law by target-specific deformation/lifting relation
require target-defined W and pi before applying the audit
difference_witness.prior_falsifier_escape_reason: The PNP congruence theorem does not assert Hodge sufficiency; it supplies only the falsification pattern. A Hodge projection may survive if semiregularity or another source theorem makes it congruent.
difference_witness.cheapest_repeat_failure_test: equal-projection/different-reachability collision under the frozen Hodge witness state

chronology.reason: The target W/pi has not yet been frozen in a canonical current-main Hodge packet. XM007 specifies the discriminator before target execution but does not claim a Hodge result.

framework_feedback.refinement: Add state_projection_congruence / equal-state-different-outcome hostile worlds to the root-coordinate-preservation benchmark family.
framework_feedback.possible_benefit: Reject compressed states that erase downstream reachability distinctions before expensive candidate search.
framework_feedback.possible_regression: Overhead and false rejection when a coarse projection is sufficient only under a theorem/hypothesis not represented in the test packet.
framework_feedback.cheapest_framework_discriminator: Frozen benchmark with projection pairs containing true congruences, planted collisions, and hypothesis-qualified congruences; score false accept, false reject, and extra-cost.
